title: 原件导入持久化故障回归 (batch / cloud / local-download / sideload)

approved_sdk.note: identical to the tree at the implementation start for src/ include/ cmake/ CMakeLists.txt

docs_seal: the docs-only commit that adds this file (its SHA is in git log and in the S11 final message); it was pushed with [skip ci] and therefore has no run of its own

failure.detail: Linux and macOS failed at the consumer link step: the C-only probe target linked the C++ EXReaderWebDAV archive without the C++ driver (undefined reference to std::string, DSO missing). Windows failed in the judge with 35 checks passed because the judge treated an unsupported Linux-only fault as a failure instead of a pending row.
failure.fix: project(... LANGUAGES C CXX) + LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX on s11-probe; unsupported faults now record a pending row (fault_supported helper).

failure.detail: Checks.equal() missing 1 required positional argument: 'expected' at check_s11.py:404 (the committed-not-revoked receipt was asserted with equal() instead of check()). 102 checks passed on Windows and macOS, 113 on Linux (batch group plus batch.nospace on Linux) before the TypeError.
failure.fix: the receipt is asserted with check() and the observed stored SHA-256 list is recorded as detail.

failure.detail: cloud.missing.download: actual "remote", expected "io" — a missing private staging directory is reported as READER_CLOUD_REMOTE instead of READER_CLOUD_IO. Staged=NULL, no commit, no row, no staging file and the directory is not created, so every non-status invariant held.
failure.reproduction: run 40218428719 row C2 on all three operating systems

B4 batch.nospace: real 256 KiB tmpfs, 3 MiB original, ENOSPC proven before use, staging empty afterwards (Linux only)
B5 batch.retry: created=1 and stored bytes/SHA-256 identical after reopen (all three OS)
B6 batch.changed: stored bytes are the staged copy, size_hint not trusted, input file unchanged (all three OS)
B7 batch.rejects: corrupt FORMAT and oversize LIMIT with committed=0, all three fixture SHA-256 unchanged, staging empty, 1 row after reopen (all three OS)
B8 batch.cancel: committed item kept, later items CANCELLED, 1 row after reopen, retry reaches 3 rows with the first still present (all three OS)
C1 cloud.ok: real TLS WebDAV download, staged_sha equals the fixture SHA-256, committed=1, created=1, staging removed, bytes and SHA-256 identical after reopen (all three OS)

evidence_source: GitHub Actions artifacts API metadata for this run attempt (id, name, size_in_bytes, digest, expires_at). No artifact bytes were downloaded or parsed outside Actions; the per-invocation probe logs, databases and staging trees are inside the listed artifacts.
not_verified: The status-name mapping for a missing/unwritable cloud staging directory (owner decision required, see the finding).
No platform was granted a host/device qualification by this package; only native library behaviour on the three CI runners is reported.
Windows and macOS cannot inject a real ENOSPC; the three nospace rows stay pending there.
next_steps: Root decides the owner question in docs/reader-final-s11/FINDING-cloud-staging-status.md (map EXR_DAV_IO to READER_CLOUD_IO, or document REMOTE for download-phase staging failures and let S11 assert it with that reason).
Then re-run this workflow once on the same tree plus the decision; rows C3-C9, S1-S6 and L1-L6 execute for the first time.
